name: EcoLite 13.3" Chromebook
description: EcoLite Chromebook provides a 13.3-inch 1080p touchscreen running Chrome OS, ideal for students and remote work. It includes an Vertex Micro Celeron N5100 processor, 8GB RAM, and 64GB eMMC storage, with cloud-centric features and built-in virus protection. The long-lasting 45Wh battery delivers up to 12 hours of usage.
shortDescription: Affordable Chromebook with a responsive touchscreen and all-day battery life.

reviews.title: Disappointing performance for a Chromebook
reviews.comment: The EcoLite 13.3" Chromebook feels sluggish when opening multiple tabs, and the processor struggles with even basic web tasks. Its battery drains faster than advertised, lasting only about five hours of light use, which is disappointing for a device marketed as portable.
